source: Owner direct chat after the proposed rifle impact multipliers
owner_message_original: Поставь эти значения, вне задачи, проверь сборку, а выстрелы я сам протестирую
owner_message_english_translation: Set these values, outside a task, check the build, and I will test the shots myself.
decision: Directly implement rifle impulse multipliers of 1.5 for a hit-associated committed living fall and 2.0 for a lethal hit. Do not stack both bonuses on the same shot; retain ordinary hit/corpse impulses and damage.
execution: No new task, Multica execution or independent review. Verify the native build only; firing and motion evaluation belong to the owner.
preservation: Preserve owner config/project/map edits, existing gameplay scope, sources and historical evidence. This direct follow-up does not dispatch any backlog task.
